brief:
Al Jazeera English reported on a journalist in Gaza City documenting the displacement of civilians as Israeli evacuation orders force her family from their home. The reporter chronicles the experience of leaving while simultaneously covering the mass movement of residents from the northern enclave.

The account captures the dual role of a media professional navigating both her professional obligation to report and her personal circumstances as a displaced person amid the conflict.
dek: When Israel orders an evacuation of Gaza City, a journalist documents the displacement while living it with her family.
title: Gaza journalist documents displacement as Israel orders evacuation
